# agyn_llm_provider (Resource)

Manages an Agyn LLM provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agyn_organization" "example" {
  name = "example-org"
}

resource "agyn_llm_provider" "example" {
  organization_id = agyn_organization.example.id
  endpoint        = "https://api.example.com"
  auth_method     = "bearer"
  token           = "example-token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_method` (String) Authentication method for the provider.
- `endpoint` (String) Provider base URL.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier for the LLM provider.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token for the provider.

### Optional

- `protocol` (String) Wire protocol the provider speaks. Must be "responses" or "anthropic_messages". Defaults to "responses".

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the LLM provider.
